hints.content:
The function is increasing, so the left Riemann sum will underestimate the actual area:

![The graph of function g has the shaded area divided into 6 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top left corner and is below the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/8b34f2287e610732780fc8359f7c56c8aca56fe3)

And the right Riemann sum will overestimate:

![The graph of function g has the shaded area divided into 6 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top right corner and rises above the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/2e928c595bb992c61b8e28c8d91825084d74fc01)

Here are the areas ordered from least to greatest:

* Left Riemann sum
* Actual area under the curve
* Right Riemann sum
